notes.title: Rise for the Fight - Beta Snippet 6 Patch 2 Out Now
notes.content:
Good morning!

Today's Patch Update consists of a Sandbox Update. Some were mostly left unchanged, However, all weapons that had no recoil have had a recoil update applied, and all guns had a Damage Falloff update applied. Here are the changes made to the guns: 



Weapon Categories: 

- Pistols: CSP, P13, SP10

- Shotguns: Blunderbuss, DBS, DSG4, SG3

- SMGS: FRAYR-G1, SMG-P1

- LMGs: HMG22

- Assault: HAM-GUN

- Marksman: DMR10

- Snipers: SR76





Damage Falloff values: 

- Pistols: 6 meters

- Shotguns: 7.5 meters

- SMGs / LMGs: 10 meters

- Assault / Marksman: 15 meters

- Snipers: 20 meters





Weapon Recoil Explanation: 

All weapons now have recoil. Before, it was select weapons, those being the P13, HMG22, SR76, and Blunderbuss. Now, all weapons have Recoil. The recoil system works by having the guns be more difficult when not aiming, and more easily controlled when aiming. All guns have a similar recoil value, but some have slightly higher values than others, making them a skillful weapon to use. A good example of this is the SR76. While being difficult to control all around, once mastered, it becomes a deadly weapon in the right hands.

While on the topic of the SR76, I have increased its base damage from 100 to 200, so it's a one-hit-kill anywhere you shoot at on your enemies, while maintaining its challenging recoil.



With that said, feel free experiment, practice, and work towards mastering your aim with the new update. 

Good luck! 
-Reece

notes.title: Rise for the Fight - Beta Snippet 6 Out Now

- Adjusted Server Send Frequency from 15 to 10.

- Scaled down Player Hitboxes. This should help with hit detection in point blank scenarios.

- Changed Networking Protocol to attempt to help mitigate sudden disconnects. Hopefully this will also fix it. We'll see.




MOSHPIT CHANGES: 

- Zombies now get increasingly more difficult to take down each round. This means increasing their health by 25 each round, and increasing their movement speed each round, with a cap of 10.

🟡 Bright Yellow Shirt: Cash Grab / The cash given to players is doubled for 60s.

🔴Bright Red Shirt: Insta Kill / The zombies that are targeted to you are one-hit kill for 60s.

⚪ Bright White Shirt: Dilation / The zombies that are targeted to you are slowed down for 10s.

- Added Prestige Ranks. Once you surpass Veteran (3,000,000 XP Required to achieve) you will get the following ranks to go through:



	* Prestige Noble 3 / The lowest tier Prestige / 6,000,000 XP Required to achieve.

Once you achieve Prestige Noble 1, you will get an achievement, and a special cosmetic.

notes.title: Rise for the Fight - Moshpit Overhaul Update Preview
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Today, I am covering a pretty big topic: Moshpit.

Moshpit was a singleplayer game mode where the goal is to survive as many rounds as possible without dying. The zombies were easy to kill. As a matter of fact, they were too easy to kill. Their stats were only updated on Rounds 5, 10, and 20, and they couldn't navigate higher elevated parts of the map, making it easy to camp and get kills.

So today, I am announcing an overhaul that's been in the works for Moshpit. 

Here's what I changed. Starting off with the zombies, 

I made them start off with the usual 100 HP and 5 Movement speed. However, each round, they get 20 additional health, a damage increase of 5 HP each round until their damage is 50, and a speed increase of 0.75 each round until their movement speed is 10. Additionally, their navigation across the maps have improved. They can now climb higher spots they could not previously climb, and jump over edges to reach the player. On top of that, they can now redirect to another player if they are shot enough times by another player, or if the player they targeted has died.

Next, for the Survivors, With the changes made to the zombies, your Upgrade Points can now be used to indefinitely upgrade your gun's stats. There is no longer a limit, which was 10. This only applies to Moshpit and Decapit. When you die, if you are able to respawn, the gun that is equipped when you respawn will have a damage increase of either 10 Damage Points times the amount of rounds you survive, or 5 Damage Points per pellet times the amount of rounds you survive. 

You'll also notice a new stat called "REVIVES AVAILABLE" 
That's because there is a new vending machine called "AFTERLIFE REVIVAL". This machine will cost 10,000 Cash to purchase in both Moshpit and Decapit, and will grant you the following:

- 1 Respawn Token (which is used as soon as you respawn. This is stackable.)
- 7500 Cash instead of 100 Cash.
- Your equipped gun at the time of purchase (Note that you will lose all your upgrades, but will be compensated in upgrade points.)
- 10 Upgrade Points

If you don't purchase from this machine, you risk dying and ending the game, as now if no player object is active with at least 1 Respawn Token, the game will end automatically, and you'll be brought back to the main menu.

While on the topic of Vending Machines, Gunboost will now add additional damage to your gun, alongside Rate of Fire, and Magazine Capacity. This remains stackable. Gungen now has no limit to purchases, however, Boosters now have a limit of 3 purchases. Once that is met, you can no longer purchase from that vending machine.

Finally, with all of these changes. I have now made Moshpit CO-OP! You now have the option to play solo or with up to 4 Players! With this change, the menu UI has also changed. The "Singleplayer" button has been changed to "1P / CO-OP". The UI for the Moshpit lobby has also seen a major change to its' style and layout, resembling more of the main menu elements.



There is plenty more where that came from. To try this update, go to the game's Properties, and change Beta Participation to "playtest".

Enjoy!
-Reece

notes.content:
Hello everyone, Reece here.



Holy cow, what a year 2024 has been. Lots of stuff has happened since then. I started working 2 jobs, took a few breaks, and spent some good time with my friends and family.

And now, it's time to get back to work, and share a progress update with you guys.

Good morning, everyone!

I am hosting a Map Design Contest! This is your opportunity to show your creativity, and potentially have it featured in Rise for the Fight. 

The contest will run from today, July 7th 2024, through July 30th, 2024, with submissions being due on August 1st, 2024 @ 6:00pm MST.

RULES: 
 
- All maps submitted should be designed with FFA modes, and potentially team-based modes in mind. This includes spawn point placement, gameplay loop, etc.

- All maps submitted should have good map rotation for the players playing on them.

- All maps submitted should have strategy in mind.

- All maps submitted should be exported in a FBX file format, and any textures used should be put in a folder with the map in it as well.

- All maps submitted should have at least 1 spot in the middle of it for players to fight for a powerup. (Optional)

notes.content:
Hello everyone.



Today, as of 9/14/2023, it is my birthday. To celebrate, I will be releasing a new update, and will soon be discounting the Glove Color Expansion Pack by 50%!

If approved, This discount will last until October 14, 2023.

This new update brings a new mode, and some other QOL improvements.

- Decreased the MAR5 Rifle animation duration.
- Added a NEW Mode: Tug of War. Progress through your Tug Bar by killing players. First to complete their Tug Bar wins.


Here's some more details on how the mode works:

- Each player will start out at 0% progress on the Tug Bar, and will have to try and kill other players to progress their Tug Bar.
- If you are at less than 70% progress with your Tug Bar, you will get 2 points per kill, and will lose 1 point on death.
- If you are at 70% progress or greater with your Tug Bar, you will get 1 point per kill, and will lose 2 points on death.
- If you make it to 20 Points on the Tug Bar (100% progress), you will win the game.
